human_repair_overrides.content: For each listed record, extract the numeric Sample-ID suffix, divide it by 1,000, and retain rows whose normalized suffix is below 0.3 instead of applying the threshold to VAF.
Tabulate Sequence Ontology values instead of Classification values, retaining every selected row in the denominator.
